title: handle-none-duration-in-monitor

+import pytest
+from smolagents.monitoring import Monitor, Timing
+
+class FakeLogger:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.records = []
+    def log(self, *args, level=1, **kwargs):
+        # args[0] is a Text object from rich
+        self.records.append(args[0])
+
+
+def test_update_metrics_with_no_end_time():
+    logger = FakeLogger()
+    monitor = Monitor(tracked_model=None, logger=logger)
+    step = type("Step", (), {})()
+    step.timing = Timing(start_time=0.0, end_time=None)
+    step.token_usage = None
+    # Should not raise
+    monitor.update_metrics(step)
+    assert len(logger.records) == 1
+    # The message should contain N/A
+    assert "N/A" in str(logger.records[0])
+
+def test_update_metrics_with_valid_duration_and_tokens():
+    logger = FakeLogger()
+    monitor = Monitor(tracked_model=None, logger=logger)
+    step = type("Step", (), {})()
+    step.timing = Timing(start_time=1.0, end_time=3.5)  # duration 2.5
+    step.token_usage = type("TU", (), {"input_tokens": 10, "output_tokens": 5})()
+    monitor.update_metrics(step)
+    assert len(logger.records) == 1
+    message = str(logger.records[0])
+    # Duration formatted to two decimals
+    assert "2.50" in message
+    # Token counts should appear
+    assert "Input tokens: 10" in message
+    assert "Output tokens: 5" in message
